title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Xufang Luo、Yuge Zhang、Zhiyuan He、Zilong Wang、Siyun Zhao、Dongsheng Li、Luna K. Qiu、Yuqing Yang
paper_type_zh: 智能体强化学习框架、可观测性轨迹接口与数据披露边界审计
best_for_zh: 关注智能体后训练、状态动作转移、OpenTelemetry 追踪、奖励设计、用户数据治理和隐私的研究者与工程人员
one_line: Microsoft's MIT framework converts user-run agent executions into state/action/reward transitions and trace spans for LightningRL, but its official release is framework code and examples—not a canonical corpus, reward ledger, environment bundle or benchmark data release.
Agent Lightning 是微软的 MIT 智能体优化框架，它将用户运行的智能体执行转换为 LightningRL 所需的状态/动作/奖励转移和 trace span；官方发布的是框架代码与示例，不是规范语料、奖励账本、环境包或基准数据发布。
why: It exposes a reusable transition and observability contract for training agents while sharply separating framework-level trace capture from the missing provenance, rights, reward validity, split and privacy evidence needed to audit any concrete downstream training run.
inclusion_reason: A Microsoft 2025 agent-optimization framework that formalizes how arbitrary agent executions are converted into state/action/reward transitions and operational traces, making its data interface and disclosure boundary highly relevant to an audit ledger even though it does not release a unified training corpus.

title: Problem
问题
html: Agent Lightning is curated for the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger as a framework and trace-schema disclosure, not as a canonical training corpus. Its user-supplied tasks and agents can be run through a client that captures executions with OpenTelemetry/AgentOps instrumentation or a basic OpenAI-like API tracer. Executions are represented as component calls with metadata, inputs and outputs; extracted training transitions contain LLM input/context, LLM output/action and scalar reward. State can also carry semantic variables, program counter, values, call stack and resource context. Structured prompts, tool calls and rewards may flow as trace spans to LightningStore, but no paper-wide execution, rollout, trace or span corpus is linked as an official artifact.

Agent Lightning 被纳入“前沿报告与数据披露账本”，因为它披露的是框架和轨迹模式，而不是规范训练语料。用户提供的任务和智能体可在客户端运行，客户端通过 OpenTelemetry/AgentOps 插桩或基础的 OpenAI 风格 API 追踪器捕获执行。执行被表示为带元数据、输入和输出的组件调用；抽取出的训练转移包含 LLM 输入/上下文、LLM 输出/动作和标量奖励。状态还可携带语义变量、程序计数器、变量值、调用栈和资源上下文。结构化提示、工具调用和奖励可作为 trace span 流向 LightningStore，但没有官方工件链接到覆盖全论文的 execution、rollout、trace 或 span 语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The framework accepts task-defined scalar rewards rather than imposing a universal verifier. AIR can optionally turn monitoring signals, such as a tool-call return status, into intermediate reward. In the paper demonstrations, text-to-SQL with Spider and calculator-assisted Calc-X math use final-answer correctness. The MuSiQue question-answering demonstration with a Wikipedia retriever uses 0.9 times word-level final-answer F1 plus 0.1 times format validity for tagged think/query/answer output. Those are three task-specific examples, not a framework-wide default reward, a reward dataset or proof that all future captured traces are programmatically verifiable. Execution completion is determined by the user task and agent runtime; a universal terminal schema and terminal-event ledger are unknown.

该框架接受任务定义的标量奖励，而不是规定通用验证器。AIR 可以选择性地将监控信号（例如一次工具调用的返回状态）转化为中间奖励。论文演示中，使用 Spider 的 text-to-SQL 与使用 Calc-X 的计算器辅助数学任务都以最终答案正确性为奖励；带 Wikipedia 检索器的 MuSiQue 问答演示使用 0.9 倍的词级最终答案 F1 加 0.1 倍带标签 think/query/answer 输出的格式有效性。这些只是三个任务专用示例，不是框架范围的默认奖励、奖励数据集，也不能证明以后捕获的每条轨迹都可程序化验证。执行完成由用户任务和智能体运行时决定；通用终止模式和终止事件账本均为 unknown。

title: Method
方法
html: The Training-Agent Disaggregation architecture has a server that coordinates user-uploaded task batches, agent clients that execute agents, LightningStore for task/resource/trace synchronization, and a backend that updates resources or models. Environments and rewards may be local to a worker or pooled shared services; no canonical environment bundle is released. LightningRL extracts input-output-reward transitions, assigns episode return across selected LLM calls and delegates token-level optimization to PPO, GRPO or REINFORCE++. The reported implementation assigns every action in an episode the same value as its final return. The three examples use Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct with LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK or AutoGen. Each task may run multiple times, but a unified corpus sampling protocol, prompt filter, rollout count, retained/rejected transition manifest, seed and checkpoint package are not disclosed.

Training-Agent Disaggregation 架构包含协调用户上传任务 batch 的服务器、执行智能体的客户端、用于任务/资源/trace 同步的 LightningStore，以及更新资源或模型的后端。环境和奖励可在 worker 本地运行，或作为共享服务池运行；没有发布规范环境包。LightningRL 抽取输入-输出-奖励转移，将 episode 回报分配给被选择的 LLM 调用，并把 token 级优化委托给 PPO、GRPO 或 REINFORCE++。报告的实现为一个 episode 中每个动作赋予最终回报的相同值。三个示例使用 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，分别采用 LangChain、OpenAI Agents SDK 或 AutoGen。每项任务可以运行多次，但统一的语料采样协议、提示筛选、rollout 数、保留/拒绝转移清单、随机种子和检查点包均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence bundle verifies the official arXiv report, Microsoft Research project page, microsoft/agent-lightning repository, MIT license and Responsible AI documentation. Microsoft describes a research-purpose framework and directs users to supply and convert their own datasets to parquet rows containing data ID, input and expected output. The paper demonstrates Spider, MuSiQue/Wikipedia and Calc-X tasks, but the repository links no paper-wide data, trace, reward, model or Hugging Face release. The official artifacts therefore establish code, documentation, examples and a trace interface; they do not establish a canonical frontier corpus, common reward ledger, environment bundle, benchmark-data release or immutable paper-run artifact set.

证据账本已核验官方 arXiv 报告、微软研究项目页、microsoft/agent-lightning 仓库、MIT 许可证和 Responsible AI 文档。微软将其描述为研究用途框架，并引导用户将自有数据转换成包含 data ID、input 与 expected output 的 parquet 行。论文演示了 Spider、MuSiQue/Wikipedia 和 Calc-X 任务，但仓库没有链接覆盖全论文的数据、trace、奖励、模型或 Hugging Face 发布。因此，官方工件建立的是代码、文档、示例和轨迹接口；它们不建立规范前沿语料、通用奖励账本、环境包、基准数据发布或不可变的论文运行工件集。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For this atlas, the distinctive contribution is a reusable observability-to-RL contract. It separates an execution collected from one agent run from the RL trajectory/episode extracted for optimization, and represents agent computation through component calls and structured trace spans. This makes state/action/reward transition extraction and resource updates inspectable across heterogeneous user agents. The distinction also matters for audit: a tracing API and framework example do not turn user data, prompts, tool outputs, traces or rewards into a released corpus. The source roles are construction recipe, verifier/reward and agent environment; evidence-backed uses are agent training and evaluation.

对本图谱而言，其区别性贡献是一个可复用的“可观测性到 RL”契约。它区分一次智能体运行收集到的 execution，与为优化而抽取出的 RL trajectory/episode，并以组件调用和结构化 trace span 表示智能体计算。这使得跨异构用户智能体检查状态/动作/奖励转移提取和资源更新成为可能。该区分对审计也很重要：追踪 API 和框架示例不会把用户数据、提示、工具输出、轨迹或奖励变成已发布语料。其来源角色为构建配方、验证器/奖励和智能体环境；有证据支持的用途为智能体训练和评估。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Equal final-return assignment to every action can misattribute credit in long, branching or multi-agent workflows. The extractor omits detailed reasons and sources that created LLM input, so a transition tuple may not preserve full provenance, tool context or semantic reproducibility. AIR status signals need not measure correctness, safety or utility. A flexible user-controlled task, agent, environment and reward interface cannot establish the quality, rights, privacy, safety or verifiability of downstream traces. OpenTelemetry/API capture can include sensitive prompts, tool outputs and resources, yet the inspected sources do not provide a general redaction, consent, retention, access-control or trace-release ledger. No paper-run input/trace/reward/checkpoint artifact, split map, contamination audit, agent/tool/service version set, seed or pinned runtime is verified. The MIT code license does not establish rights for user data, benchmarks, retriever content, external tools or captured traces.

向 episode 中每个动作赋予相同最终回报，可能在长程、分支或多智能体工作流中错误归因。抽取器省略产生 LLM 输入的详细原因和来源，因此一个转移元组可能不保留完整溯源、工具上下文或语义可复现性。AIR 状态信号不一定衡量正确性、安全性或效用。灵活的用户控制任务、智能体、环境和奖励接口不能建立下游轨迹的质量、权利、隐私、安全性或可验证性。OpenTelemetry/API 捕获可能包含敏感提示、工具输出和资源，但已核验来源没有提供通用的脱敏、同意、保留、访问控制或轨迹发布账本。未核验到论文运行的输入/轨迹/奖励/检查点工件、切分映射、污染审计、智能体/工具/服务版本集、随机种子或固定运行时。MIT 代码许可证也不能建立用户数据、基准、检索内容、外部工具或捕获轨迹的权利。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Evidence-backed uses are agent training and evaluation at the framework-interface level. The Card supports comparison of execution-versus-training-trajectory schemas, state/action/reward extraction, optional AIR signals, equal-return credit assignment and task-specific demo rewards. It should not be used to claim access to a common Agent Lightning corpus, a standard reward verifier, a canonical environment, a user trace release or privacy-cleared data. A concrete downstream run requires its own source-rights, consent/privacy, redaction/retention, task/split, reward-calibration, trace lineage and reproducibility evidence.

有证据支持的用途是在框架接口层面开展智能体训练和评估。本卡支持比较 execution 与训练 trajectory 的模式、状态/动作/奖励抽取、可选 AIR 信号、等回报归因和任务专用 demo 奖励。它不应被用于声称获得了通用的 Agent Lightning 语料、标准奖励验证器、规范环境、用户轨迹发布或已解决隐私的数据。一个具体的下游运行需要各自的来源权利、同意/隐私、脱敏/保留、任务/切分、奖励校准、轨迹血缘和可复现性证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Interface unit to inspect: execution component calls and extracted LLM input, LLM output, scalar-reward transitions and trace spans.
  • Demonstration rewards to verify: final-answer correctness for Spider text-to-SQL and Calc-X math; 0.9 answer F1 plus 0.1 format validity for MuSiQue RAG.
  • Framework boundary to preserve: user supplies datasets, agents, environments and rewards; no canonical trace/reward/model/benchmark corpus is linked.
  • Reuse gate before relying on a run: source rights, privacy/consent/redaction, trace and credit lineage, split/contamination analysis, reward validation and pinned runtime evidence.

• 应核查的接口单元：execution 组件调用，以及抽取出的 LLM 输入、LLM 输出、标量奖励转移和 trace span。
  • 应核查的演示奖励：Spider text-to-SQL 与 Calc-X 数学任务的最终答案正确性；MuSiQue RAG 的 0.9 答案 F1 加 0.1 格式有效性。
  • 应保留的框架边界：用户提供数据集、智能体、环境和奖励；没有链接规范 trace/奖励/模型/基准语料。
  • 依赖一次运行前的复用门槛：来源权利、隐私/同意/脱敏、轨迹和归因血缘、切分/污染分析、奖励验证和固定运行时证据。
